title: My first flight
instructions: Ali ilk uçak yolculuğunu anlatıyor. Nereye gittiğine ve nasıl hissettiğine dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I took my first flight when I was twenty.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I flew from Istanbul to London for a job interview.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I was very nervous at first, especially when the plane took off.

script.speaker: s
script.text: But the flight attendants were friendly, and I watched two films.

script.speaker: s
script.text: When we landed, I wasn't scared any more. Now I love flying!

questions.prompt: How old was Ali on his first flight?
questions.evidence: I took my first flight when I was twenty.

questions.prompt: Why did he fly to London?
